row.body: The service ledger records a final pickup; a note asks the next shift to keep the room ventilated after the cleaning crew leaves.
row.title: Service after the last wait

sidecar.gloss: A room is aired after the final pickup.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response crew could ventilate a room after ordinary cleaning; the ledger does not identify what was cleaned.

row.body: a feed-sack thread binds the eraser to the hand torch; a strip of road tape reinforces the same knot.
row.title: two traces on the eraser

sidecar.gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
sidecar.rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.
